original_sources_visually_checked.file: src/papers/PDF/Lian 2021 seepage flow unsaturated porous media.pdf

open_soil_surface: Eq71 gives pressure head h_w<=0. At each completed step only positive head is set to zero; otherwise the rate equation continues. Eq72 separately treats the free-surface rate without the Eq57 error-removal term. This is not an unconditional zero-pressure Dirichlet surface.
surface_identification: Eq68 uses the volume-weighted kernel support sum below .95; Fig10 distinguishes real surface soil particles from wall support particles. Mapping to current FS2/3 tracking requires an actual compatibility test, not a label equivalence assumption.
impermeable_wall: Eq73 imposes approximately zero normal flow components; Eq74 gives receiver-local copies H_v=H_k, h_v=h_k and k_v=k_k. The original text does not supply a global single-valued MLS mirror pressure formula or a special wall-top contact switch. Simultaneously copying total and pressure head at different elevations needs an explicit geometric interpretation.
current_code: CPU JSphCpu.cpp ApplyFreeSurfacePorePressure and rate resets; GPU JSphGpu_ker.cu corresponding free-surface kernels impose zero pressure and rate on active drained fluid FS2/3, including negative pressure. Fixed wall quadrature is outside that fluid predicate.
case08_implication: Retain accepted fixed-zero drainage as the default. Add and independently verify the paper-compatible free-seepage/rate policy at its planned hydraulic-boundary stage; do not silently change existing 1D/Cryer inputs or only remove the negative-pressure reset without checking the surface operator.
geometry_implication: No paper basis was found for a fixed H-height dry-wall switch or treating numerical wall samples above the initial free surface as atmospheric soil owners. Separate fluid free-surface status, true wall interaction and numerical fit quality. Recenter alone establishes none of those physical conditions.
